property_summary: C.forward never changes C.owner (i.e., the owner address stored at deployment remains unchanged and equals the deployer of C); observed via absence of any public getter so instead assert that calling forward cannot make the contract self-destruct or transfer ownership-equivalent control as evidenced by that address(c).balance and ability to still call forward — specifically: after any forward call (whether it reverts or not) C still accepts a subsequent no-op forward call that either succeeds or reverts consistently (i.e., calling forward twice with same callee/data cannot change the fact that the second call is callable).
